ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping Districts; B3-1, Community Shopping Districts; B3-2,
Community Shopping Districts; B3-3, Community Shopping Districts; M1-2, Limited
Manufacturing/Business Park Districts; and C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial Districts
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 18-C, Map No. 20-C, Map No. 18-B, and
Map No. 20-B in the area bound by:

South Paxton Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 79" Street;
South Crandon Avenue; the north right-of-way line of the Baltimore and Ohio
Railroad; South Oglesby Avenue; a line 164.8 feet north of and parallel to East
79" Street; South Yates Boulevard; the alley next north of and parallel to East
79" Street; South Colfax Avenue; a line 97 feet north of and parallel to East 79"
Street; South Saginaw Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 79"
Street; South Escanaba Avenue; a line 100 feet south of and parallel to East 79"
Street; South Muskegon Avenue; a line 75 feet south of and parallel to East 79"
Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Burnham Avenue; the alley
next south of and parallel to East 79" Street; South Phillips Avenue; the south
right-of-way line of the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad; South Yates Boulevard; a
line 121.14 feet south of and parallel to East 79" Street; South Oglesby Avenue;
and the alley next south of and parallel to East 79" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

‘Saat mete
Alder Ward

2201-2853 E. 79th Street
